patterns_found.visual_evidence: The mobile sketch shows a narrow horizontal navigation bar directly under the header with a small boxed three-line icon on the right, a conventional hamburger trigger for collapsed navigation.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Tapping the icon should open and close the primary navigation panel for small screens. The trigger should expose current expanded/collapsed state and likely reveal the same nav links visible inline on desktop.
patterns_found.ambiguities: The sketch does not show whether the menu opens as a dropdown below the bar, an off-canvas drawer, or a full-screen overlay.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a mostly static content page with very low JavaScript complexity. The only clearly indicated interactive behavior is responsive navigation on mobile via a hamburger toggle; the desktop version appears to show the same content without an equivalent collapsed control. No search, tabs, accordions, modals, sticky behavior, pagination controls, or explicit dynamic loading cues are visibly suggested by the drawings.
